Their rate of speed was slow. They were silent.  Each of the objects was egg-shaped and emitted a soft neon-like color, almost like pastel.  
Each object was of a different color: the 'lead' was blue; the others were red, yellow and white. There were no physical obstructions for those observing the objects, such as trees or buildings. 
Most of the observers were senior individuals as they were there in the yard in celebration of a birthday. All saw the objects; some joked about them. 
The sighting itself captured my attention and I was awestruck at the beauty of what I was seeing.
Date may be approximate, although the witness does not indicate that fact.  PD

description: My mom and I were walking to the library around 7pm on a weeknight when we spotted a circular shaped object coming towards us from the south (I was 7 yrs old, my mom 27 at the time). It stopped over a transformer above us a few feet west of us and maybe 500-700 feet above us. It just hovered there for a few minutes. We thought it was either waiting for a plane to pass by or drawing power from the transformer. After a few minutes of hovering it slowly moved going east, passing over us heading east towards Lake Michigan. The thing that I can not explain is how quiet the object was. Nothing I know of can move, stop, change directions and move again so quietly, not a sound. The size of the craft was about the size of a basketball held at arms length, and I'd guess it was no higher than 500 or so feet. I remember the color being a yellowish changing to orange color that changed back to yellow, then orange. My mom remembers more lighting on its edges, like a ring of lights (I remember when we were looking at the object her saying that to me, and I never did see the ring of lights, she said it might be because of our height difference, I was a short 7 yr old then). summary: Huge, bright orb in sky over Seattle in 1960s.
description:
This happened between 1964 and 1967. It was before the sun came up and through the trees at Belfair near Hood Canal there was a huge sun like object low in the sky, perhaps to the west.  It did not move and I watched it until daylight when it just faded away into the sky.
At that time Frosty Fowler has doing his radio show from the Seattle Space Needle and he commented on it several times. Thousands of people must have seen it. Frosty wroked for KING radio so maybe you can track him down. After all these years I'm not certain of the date it happened but it was scary.
Date is approximate.  We would welcome other reports from residents in Washington State who might have seen the object, or who might have heard the broadcast.  PD

summary: 1965 in Indianapolis, In- planet looking object was seen hovering over 2 story home,no lights or sound
description:
Aprox. 1965 or 1967, I lived in the Indianapolis area of Indiana. I was in first or second grade. I was walking to school one day when I saw an object above a house. It was above a two story home and much larger than the home it was above. The object looked like a planet. It had two diffent colors or at least darker and lighter areas, but no lights or windows. It made no sound at all. It just hovered above the home, didn't get higher or lower, and just rotated in a circle above the home.
 I was standing on the side walk in front of this home. So, I got a good look at this object.I remember looking at it for windows or lights. I watched it for awhile, and then decided I should go home and tell somebody. When I got back with my parents, it was gone. They told me others had reported it also.
 I can't be exact on the year, but I think it was 1965. And, it must have been winter because when I got to school, I remember the teacher telling me I was late and hurry up and take my coat off. I remember the coat was a heavy winter coat. I also have no idea on how long I watched the object.
 I still wonder what it was after all of these years. I hope someone else saw this and knows.

summary: Giant circle over high school
description:
Saw a large circle at about 600 feet over Eastside High School early morning.  I was about a block away and almost under it when I first saw it.  It was twice as large as a hot air balloon.  It was brownish in color with a darker brown smooth center about half its diameter, and nothing hanging down.  It was elevating quietly and slowly at about 1,000 feet as I entered the High School.  Thinking that it was a giant helium balloon from the school never reported the sight.  Year and month are approximate.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate.  PD

summary: 5 police officers in 1965 were attacked.
description:
It was 3:00 AM.  I was a police officer, and the year is 1965.  We were parked off to the side of the road to catch speeders, until I looked up into the night sky and saw two oblique orbs that were white  in the black sky.  They seemed to be hooked upon the high powered traffic wire.  They must have been 2 feet in depth, and 1 foot across.  They were floating up at 35 feet.  As we watched, me and my partner were dead quiet.  
Then, I decided to get out of the squad car; my partner stayed in the car.  The orb proceeded forward, and then my partner keyed  into the radio and mic.  Then the orb sped off to my right, getting smaller and smaller.  
At that time, we made separate reports because, at the time in California, sighted ufos by officers were common, and they had to make separate reports.
